description: This file provides functions to send and remove reactions via the Signal CLI JSON-RPC API, including handling configuration, normalizing IDs, and constructing RPC requests.

methods.name: loadSignalConfigRuntime
methods.description: Loads the Signal plugin configuration runtime asynchronously.

methods.name: normalizeSignalId
methods.description: Removes 'signal:' prefix and trims the raw signal ID.

methods.name: normalizeSignalUuid
methods.description: Normalizes a signal ID or UUID, removing 'uuid:' prefix if present.

methods.name: resolveTargetAuthorParams
methods.description: Resolves target author parameters, normalizing UUIDs.

methods.name: sendReactionSignalCore
methods.description: Core function to send or remove a reaction signal via RPC.

methods.name: sendReactionSignal
methods.description: Sends a reaction to a Signal message.

methods.name: removeReactionSignal
methods.description: Removes a reaction from a Signal message.
